Terms of use

Last updated November 12, 2026

These terms apply when you use Agape: to order at an event, to work as a runner or at a stand, or to use the website. By using Agape you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use Agape.

What Agape does

Agape lets fans at live events order food, drinks and merchandise from the venue's own stands and have it brought to their seat or picked up. The stands make and sell the items; Agape takes the order, handles payment, and arranges delivery by independent runners.

Your account

  • Keep your password to yourself. You're responsible for what's done with your account.
  • Give a real seat so a runner can find you, and be there when your order arrives.
  • One person per account. Accounts can be suspended for fraud, abuse, or repeated false claims.

Orders and prices

  • Prices, taxes and the delivery fee are shown before you order. The arrival time is our honest estimate from how fast the stand and runners are going right now; it isn't a guarantee.
  • When you order, an amount may be held on your card. You're charged only when your order is complete: for what was delivered, less any credit you used. If the order doesn't happen, the hold is released.
  • A stand can decline an order it can't make. If that happens you're not charged.
  • You can cancel until the stand starts making your order.

Tips

Tips go entirely to the runner who brings your order.

Age-restricted items

Alcohol and other age-restricted items are only handed over after a valid ID shows you're old enough, and only within the venue's and the law's limits. If you can't show ID, or you appear intoxicated, the item won't be handed over.

When something goes wrong

  • If an order is missing, wrong, or ruined, report it in the app during or soon after the event. We may ask for a photo.
  • Depending on what happened, we'll put it right with a replacement, a credit, or a refund to your card. Credit is often the fastest way.
  • Questions about the food itself, such as taste or ingredients, are the stand's to answer; tell us and we'll pass it on.

Runners and stands

Runners are independent contractors, not Agape employees. They choose when to work and which trips to take. Stands are run by the venue or its food service company, which is responsible for what it makes and sells, including allergens and food safety.

Partners and offers

Offers from nearby businesses are provided by those businesses. Their limits, such as how many are available and until when, are shown before you unlock one. Points have no cash value and can't be sold for money.

Using Agape fairly

Don't misuse Agape: no fake orders, false claims, harassment of runners or staff, attempts to break or overload the service, or using it for anything unlawful.

The service

We work hard to keep Agape running, but it may sometimes be unavailable, for example if a venue's network fails. Agape is provided as it is, and to the extent the law allows, Agape isn't liable for indirect losses, such as missing part of an event. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have that can't be limited by law.

Changes

We may update these terms. We'll change the date above, and tell you in the app if the change is significant. Using Agape after a change means you accept it.

Contact

Questions about these terms: write to us.
